summary_en: CKD Corporation authorized the acquisition of up to 1.30 million shares (1.94% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 5.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from October 27, 2026 to December 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares (Progress of Disclosure Items) (Acquisition of Treasury Shares Based on Articles of Incorporation as Provided in Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
On October 19, 2026, CKD Corporation announced the confirmation of the acquisition period for its treasury share buyback program, which was initially approved by the Board of Directors on October 7, 2026. The acquisition period was finalized following the determination of the offering price related to the company's planned public offering of new shares.

The company is authorized to acquire up to 1.30 million shares of its common stock, representing 1.94% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum total expenditure of 5.0 billion yen. The shares will be acquired through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period extends from October 27, 2026 to December 30, 2026, commencing from the business day following the settlement date of the public offering (which is the sixth business day after the offering price determination date). The company noted that partial or complete non-execution of the acquisition is possible depending on market conditions.
